{"en":"...","notes":"..."}

(none)

However, it seems Levia did not grasp that, and she has gotten overly enthusiastic about it. Even the intel that started this mission is dubious: a tale of the princess who went missing eighteen years ago being sighted in this city, still looking exactly as she did then..."

      "block_id": "s1:block:00284-00287",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "たとえ貴族共には認められなくとも、\n一匹で一国の軍隊に匹敵する化け物を倒したのだ、\n返上する程の汚名でもあるまい",

      "block_id": "s1:block:00289-00290",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "あの化け物を倒したのは貴様だ",
      "en": "It was you who defeated that monster."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00292-00293",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "俺一人では倒せなかった",
      "en": "I could not have defeated it alone."

    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00295-00297",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",

      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",

      "block_id": "s1:block:00303-00304",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "あ……すまない、今の言葉は忘れてくれ",

      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",

    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00309-00310",

      "jp": "どこへ行く？",

      "jp": "レヴィアが歩きだそうとしたのを見て、既に沢山の荷物を\n持っているにも拘わらず、俺の手にした荷物まで持とうと\n手を伸ばしてくるシュリを躱しながら何気なく聞いた\n俺の問いに、返ってきた歯切れの悪い答えは以外なものだった。",

      "block_id": "s1:block:00332-00333",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "何があった？",
      "en": "What happened?"
    },

      "block_id": "s1:block:00335-00336",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "……",
      "en": "..."

      "block_id": "s1:block:00338-00338",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,

      "block_id": "s1:block:00356-00358",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Ranzabu",
      "jp": "彼らからすればレヴィア将軍に少しでも快適な環境で\n事に当たって頂きたいと思ったのでしょうが……",

      "block_id": "s1:block:00360-00360",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "ランザブは、さも困ったと言わんばかりに首を左右に振る。",
      "en": "Ranzabu shakes his head, as if troubled."

    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00362-00368",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Ranzabu",
      "jp": "結局この街の領主には相応の礼金を支払い\n屋敷を借り受けると言う事で話が付いたのですが\nその平民上がりの騎士らの配慮が足りないばかりに\n我々はこの街で侵略者扱いされているのですよ",

      "block_id": "s1:block:00370-00371",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,

      "en": "Indeed, the eyes of the townspeople watching us are far from friendly."

      "page_role": "dialogue",

      "jp": "生き神として王宮の最奥に祭られている彼女は\n俺達に療養させる為に神託という形で今回の任務を与え\n戦後のごたごたの治まっていない国内から出してくれた。\nだが、レヴィアにはそこらへんが伝わらなかったらしく、\n過剰な程に張り切ってしまっているようだ。\nこの任務の発端となった情報も、十八年前に行方不明に\nなった王女が当時の姿の儘この街で見かけられているという、\n眉唾物の話だと言うのに……",
      "en": "Enshrined as a living deity deep within the royal palace, she gave us this mission as an oracle to let us recuperate, and sent us out of the country while the postwar turmoil had yet to settle. However, it seems Levia did not grasp that, and she has gotten overly enthusiastic about it. Even the intel that started this mission is dubious: a tale of the princess who went missing eighteen years ago being sighted in this city, still looking exactly as she did then..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00284-00287",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "たとえ貴族共には認められなくとも、\n一匹で一国の軍隊に匹敵する化け物を倒したのだ、\n返上する程の汚名でもあるまい",
      "en": "Even if the nobles do not acknowledge it,\nwe defeated a monster that rivals an entire army,\nit is no disgrace to be cleared."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00289-00290",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "あの化け物を倒したのは貴様だ",
      "en": "It was you who defeated that monster."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00292-00293",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "俺一人では倒せなかった",
      "en": "I could not have defeated it alone."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00295-00297",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "黙れ！　奴に止めを刺したのは貴様だ。\n私は……兵達を無駄に死なせてしまった……",
      "en": "Shut up! It was you who dealt the final blow. I... I let my soldiers die for nothing..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00299-00301",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "レヴィア……戦いの中で散っていった命を\n無駄と言うのは感心しないな",
      "en": "Levia... Calling the lives lost in battle\na waste isn't something I approve of."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00303-00304",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "あ……すまない、今の言葉は忘れてくれ",
      "en": "Ah... Sorry, forget I said that."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00306-00307",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "ああ",
      "en": "Yeah."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00309-00310",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "自らの失言によって急に怒りが冷め気恥ずかしくなったのか、\nレヴィアは顔を隠すように踵を返した。",
      "en": "Perhaps embarrassed by her own slip, her anger quickly cooling, Levia turned away as if to hide her face."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00312-00314",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "取り敢えず、現在までの調査結果を伝える、\n付いて来てくれ",
      "en": "For now, I will report the investigation results so far. Follow me."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00316-00317",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "どこへ行く？",
      "en": "Where to?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00319-00322",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "レヴィアが歩きだそうとしたのを見て、既に沢山の荷物を\n持っているにも拘わらず、俺の手にした荷物まで持とうと\n手を伸ばしてくるシュリを躱しながら何気なく聞いた\n俺の問いに、返ってきた歯切れの悪い答えは以外なものだった。",
      "en": "Seeing Levia about to walk off, I casually asked, 'Where to?' while dodging Shuri, who, already loaded with bags, was reaching out to take the one I was holding. And the hesitant answer that came back was unexpected."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00324-00325",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "王女の捜索本部として……この街の領主の館を徴収した",
      "en": "I commandeered the local mansion... for our search."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00327-00330",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "徴収、略奪は、レヴィアが最も嫌う事の一つだ。\n更に王女の探索という名目で訪れたこのミルフェの街は\nレウィニアの領土ではなく、其の行為は侵略行為として\n取られかねない",
      "en": "Levia despises commandeering and looting above all.\nAnd this city Milfe we came to under the pretext\nof finding the princess is not Lewinian land;\nit could be seen as an act of aggression."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00332-00333",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "何があった？",
      "en": "What happened?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00335-00336",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "……",
      "en": "..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00338-00338",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "黙っているレヴィアの横から一人の男が進み出てきた。",
      "en": "A man stepped forward from beside the silent Levia."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00344-00346",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Ranzabu",
      "jp": "セリカ殿、その件でしたら、レヴィア将軍を慕った\n一部の平民上がりの騎士達によって行われた事なのですよ",
      "en": "Lord Celica, that matter was carried out by\nsome common-born knights who admire General Levia."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00351-00352",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "ランザブ卿……レヴィアが率いる騎士団の副将を\n務めているのだが……何かと黒い噂の絶えない男だ。",
      "en": "Lord Ranzabu... the vice-commander of Levia's knight order, a man of endless dark rumors."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00356-00358",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Ranzabu",
      "jp": "彼らからすればレヴィア将軍に少しでも快適な環境で\n事に当たって頂きたいと思ったのでしょうが……",
      "en": "They must have wanted General Levia to have a comfortable environment to work in, but..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00360-00360",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "ランザブは、さも困ったと言わんばかりに首を左右に振る。",
      "en": "Ranzabu shakes his head, as if troubled."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00362-00368",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Ranzabu",
      "jp": "結局この街の領主には相応の礼金を支払い\n屋敷を借り受けると言う事で話が付いたのですが\nその平民上がりの騎士らの配慮が足りないばかりに\n我々はこの街で侵略者扱いされているのですよ",
      "en": "In the end, we paid the lord a suitable sum and settled on renting the mansion. However, because those common-born knights lacked foresight, we are being treated as invaders in this city."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00370-00371",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "確かに、先程から此方を窺っている街の住人の眼には\nあまり好意的なものは含まれていない。",
      "en": "Indeed, the eyes of the townspeople watching us are far from friendly."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00377-00378",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "もうよいランザブ卿、全ては済んだ事だ……",
      "en": "Enough, Lord Ranzabu... What's done is done."
    }
  ]

      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "生き神として王宮の最奥に祭られている彼女は\n俺達に療養させる為に神託という形で今回の任務を与え\n戦後のごたごたの治まっていない国内から出してくれた。\nだが、レヴィアにはそこらへんが伝わらなかったらしく、\n過剰な程に張り切ってしまっているようだ。\nこの任務の発端となった情報も、十八年前に行方不明に\nなった王女が当時の姿の儘この街で見かけられているという、\n眉唾物の話だと言うのに……",
      "en": "Enshrined as a living deity deep within the royal palace, she gave us this mission as an oracle to let us recuperate, and sent us out of the country while the postwar turmoil had yet to settle. However, it seems Levia did not grasp that, and she has gotten overly enthusiastic about it.       "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "たとえ貴族共には認められなくとも、\n一匹で一国の軍隊に匹敵する化け物を倒したのだ、\n返上する程の汚名でもあるまい",
      "en": "Even if the nobles don't acknowledge it,\nwe destroyed a monster that could match an army.\nThere's no disgrace to clear."

      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "あの化け物を倒したのは貴様だ",
      "en": "It was you who defeated that monster."

    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00292-00293",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "俺一人では倒せなかった",
      "en": "I could not have defeated it alone."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00295-00297",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "黙れ！　奴に止めを刺したのは貴様だ。\n私は……兵達を無駄に死なせてしまった……",
      "en": "Shut up! It was you who dealt the final blow.\nI... I let my soldiers die for nothing..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00299-00301",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "レヴィア……戦いの中で散っていった命を\n無駄と言うのは感心しないな",
      "en": "Levia... Calling the lives lost in battle\na waste isn't something I approve of."

    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00303-00304",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "あ……すまない、今の言葉は忘れてくれ",

      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "ああ",
      "en": "Yeah."

    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00309-00310",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "自らの失言によって急に怒りが冷め気恥ずかしくなったのか、\nレヴィアは顔を隠すように踵を返した。",
      "en": "Perhaps embarrassed by her slip, her anger quickly\ncooling, Levia turned away as if to hide her face."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00312-00314",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "取り敢えず、現在までの調査結果を伝える、\n付いて来てくれ",
      "en": "For now, I'll brief you on our findings. Come with me."

    {

      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "どこへ行く？",
      "en": "Where to?"

    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00319-00322",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "レヴィアが歩きだそうとしたのを見て、既に沢山の荷物を\n持っているにも拘わらず、俺の手にした荷物まで持とうと\n手を伸ばしてくるシュリを躱しながら何気なく聞いた\n俺の問いに、返ってきた歯切れの悪い答えは以外なものだった。",
      "en": "Levia had started to leave. I casually asked where, dodging Shuri. She, already laden with bags, reached for mine. Her halting reply was unexpected."

    {

      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "王女の捜索本部として……この街の領主の館を徴収した",
      "en": "As our search headquarters... I commandeered the local lord's mansion."

      "block_id": "s1:block:00327-00330",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "徴収、略奪は、レヴィアが最も嫌う事の一つだ。\n更に王女の探索という名目で訪れたこのミルフェの街は\nレウィニアの領土ではなく、其の行為は侵略行為として\n取られかねない",
      "en": "Levia hates commandeering and looting above all.\nAnd this city Milfe we came to under the pretext\nof finding the princess is not Lewinian territory;\nthis could be taken as an act of aggression."

    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00332-00333",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "何があった？",
      "en": "What happened?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00335-00336",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "……",
      "en": "..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00338-00338",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "黙っているレヴィアの横から一人の男が進み出てきた。",
      "en": "A man stepped forward from beside the silent Levia."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00344-00346",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Ranzabu",
      "jp": "セリカ殿、その件でしたら、レヴィア将軍を慕った\n一部の平民上がりの騎士達によって行われた事なのですよ",
      "en": "Lord Celica, regarding that matter, it was carried out by some of the common-born knights who admire General Levia."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00351-00352",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "ランザブ卿……レヴィアが率いる騎士団の副将を\n務めているのだが……何かと黒い噂の絶えない男だ。",
      "en": "Lord Ranzabu... the vice-commander of Levia's knight order, a man of endless dark rumors."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00356-00358",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Ranzabu",
      "jp": "彼らからすればレヴィア将軍に少しでも快適な環境で\n事に当たって頂きたいと思ったのでしょうが……",
      "en": "They must have wanted General Levia to have\na comfortable environment to work in, but..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00360-00360",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "ランザブは、さも困ったと言わんばかりに首を左右に振る。",
      "en": "Ranzabu shakes his head, as if troubled."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00362-00368",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Ranzabu",
      "jp": "結局この街の領主には相応の礼金を支払い\n屋敷を借り受けると言う事で話が付いたのですが\nその平民上がりの騎士らの配慮が足りないばかりに\n我々はこの街で侵略者扱いされているのですよ",
      "en": "In the end, we paid the lord a fair sum to rent his mansion. But those common-born knights' thoughtlessness has left the city treating us like invaders."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00370-00371",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "確かに、先程から此方を窺っている街の住人の眼には\nあまり好意的なものは含まれていない。",
      "en": "Indeed, the locals watching us\nhave unfriendly eyes."

    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00377-00378",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "もうよいランザブ卿、全ては済んだ事だ……",
